title: Squared mass of the prescribed Fourier kernel
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\mathcal F$ be a nonempty finite family of subsets of $\{1,\ldots,n\}$, and let $x\in\{-1,1\}^n$. For each $a\in\{-1,1\}^n$, form the function whose value at $y$ is the sum over $S\in\mathcal F$ of the Fourier coefficient of the indicator of $a$, on $S$, times the $S$-monomial of $y$, and multiply this function by $2^n/|\mathcal F|$; then the sum of its squared values at $x$, over all $a\ne x$, is $2^n/|\mathcal F|-1$.
hypotheses_covered: $\mathcal F$ is a finite family of subsets of the $n$ coordinates
$x$ is an element of the sign cube $\{-1,1\}^n$
